summary: Each of the nine previously drafted high-impact missing meanings was compared at the whole-object/type and defining-condition level against all 16 existing independent provisional meanings (20 formulations); no exact identity was supported. This is a review-only negative comparison at the version-pinned candidate/provisional corpus, not first-generation source research, citation verification, or a permission to admit/resolve anything.

provisional_population_index.label: congruence modulo a positive integer
provisional_population_index.context: Elementary number theory: congruence of integers modulo a fixed positive integer

provisional_population_index.label: trace of a square matrix
provisional_population_index.context: Finite-dimensional linear algebra: n-by-n square matrices over a field K, n≥1

provisional_population_index.label: affine hull
provisional_population_index.context: Finite-dimensional real affine geometry: subsets of R^d, integer d≥1, with empty hull allowed

provisional_population_index.label: independent events
provisional_population_index.context: Probability theory: two measurable events in a probability space, including probability-zero cases

provisional_population_index.label: mutually independent events
provisional_population_index.context: Probability theory: joint independence of an arbitrary indexed family of measurable events

provisional_population_index.label: pairwise independent events
provisional_population_index.context: Probability theory: pairwise but not necessarily jointly independent indexed measurable events

provisional_population_index.label: cycle in a simple undirected graph
provisional_population_index.context: Graph theory: a finite cycle in a loopless simple undirected graph; length at least three

provisional_population_index.label: outer measure
provisional_population_index.context: Measure theory: extended nonnegative outer measure on the full power set of an arbitrary set X

provisional_population_index.label: metric outer measure
provisional_population_index.context: Measure theory on a nonempty metric space (X,d): metric additivity strengthening of a full-power-set outer measure

provisional_population_index.label: connected topological space
provisional_population_index.context: Point-set topology: connectedness of any topological space, including the empty space

provisional_population_index.label: left group action
provisional_population_index.context: Abstract algebra: left action of a group G on an arbitrary set X

provisional_population_index.label: right group action
provisional_population_index.context: Abstract algebra: right action of a group G on an arbitrary set X

provisional_population_index.label: bounded linear transformation
provisional_population_index.context: Functional analysis: linear map X→Y between real or complex normed spaces with one global bound

provisional_population_index.label: norm of a bounded linear transformation
provisional_population_index.context: Functional analysis: operator norm on real/complex bounded linear maps between normed spaces

provisional_population_index.label: proper vertex k-coloring
provisional_population_index.context: Graph theory: fixed integer k≥1, loopless simple undirected graph; coloring need not use every palette color

provisional_population_index.label: contraction mapping
provisional_population_index.context: Metric spaces: globally Lipschitz mapping with a constant strictly below one
